objective: Preserve the current ten-coin V6 core as the primary profit engine. Use exactly the otherwise idle/free 250-USDC capacity with up to five preemptible satellite markets, and reclaim that capacity for any valid core entry as soon as the runtime can execute the handoff.
priorities: preserve every valid current ten-coin core opportunity; satellites must never cause a core trade that would otherwise execute to be missed
when the core has genuinely free/idle capacity, deploy that capacity only into separately validated satellite opportunities with positive incremental after-cost expectancy
when a valid core signal arrives, cancel conflicting pending satellite entries and exit/trim satellite exposure as needed to release USDC for the core at the first executable runtime opportunity
measure satellite success by incremental shared-portfolio net profit during core-idle periods, not by standalone satellite returns or raw trade count
reduce zero-position hours and longest idle stretches without weakening the core
model fees, spread, slippage, handoff latency and forced satellite-exit losses
preserve future-readiness, stress, red-team and governance gates
research_fronts: idle-satellite five-market selection from current Binance Spot USDC markets
satellite handoff and forced-exit mechanics when core signals arrive
historical proxy research for mature assets whose USDC pair is newer, followed by real-USDC holdout validation
idle-capital secondary strategy with >=50 USDC tranches
hybrid slot routing and handoff priority
original basis-signal filtering for meaningful notional trades
success_rule: A candidate is an activity success only if it reaches at least 157 completed position cycles over three years, uses meaningful >=50 USDC tranches, stays at or above 85% of protected-incumbent ending equity in both baseline and stress, and passes drawdown, future-readiness, red-team, A09 and A11 gates. Continue research after success toward GOOD then STRETCH tiers.

profit_concession.note: Activity candidates may trade some historical ending equity for materially lower idle time, but collapse toward ~1000 from a ~1500-1560 incumbent is unacceptable.

satellite_layer.core_reclaim_rule: A satellite has no right to keep capital once a valid core entry needs it. Pending conflicting satellite entries are cancelled; open satellite exposure is exited or reduced at the first executable runtime opportunity so capital can return to USDC and be allocated to the core.
satellite_layer.handoff_semantics: first executable opportunity under the same closed-bar/order-timing semantics used by Backtest, Paper and Live; never assume impossible intrabar clairvoyance
satellite_layer.cross_quote_conversion_policy: Do not add USDT/other quote conversion to the product path unless a separate experiment proves that additional spread, fees, latency, exchange filters and failure modes improve shared-portfolio net profit versus direct USDC routing.
satellite_layer.selection_metric: incremental shared-portfolio net profit earned specifically during core-idle/free-slot periods after all trading costs, quote-conversion costs if any, and forced core-handoff losses
success_requires: incremental satellite net PnL > 0 in baseline and stress
handoff losses do not dominate satellite gains
real-USDC holdout and regional market availability pass
cross-window, shifted-3y, future-readiness and red-team pass

capital_state_machine.CORE_ACTIVE: Core positions/signals own capital first; satellites may use only truly free capacity.
capital_state_machine.CORE_IDLE: Validated satellites may temporarily deploy free capital to earn incremental after-cost profit.
capital_state_machine.CORE_SIGNAL_ARRIVES: Reclaim required capital from satellites, return it to USDC, and route it to the valid core entry at the first executable runtime opportunity.
capital_state_machine.CORE_RECLAIMED: Core trade proceeds; satellite may re-enter only later if capacity becomes genuinely idle again.

satellite_layer.target_example_only: Higher utilization and ending equity are desirable, but no historical result is a guarantee.
